summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Bob Bakker as head of Investor Relations, effective June 18, 2026. Bakker succeeds Sjoerd Miltenburg, who was appointed head of Wholesale Banking in the Netherlands. Bakker has been part of ING's IR team since 2019, most recently as Senior IR Officer, and will report to CFO Ida Lerner. No financial terms, shareholder vote, or regulatory approvals are required. This is a routine management change with no deal mechanics or risk-arb angle. What to watch: Bakker's communication strategy and any shifts in shareholder engagement.
